# Reference: batch commands

The 167 commands a batch can contain. The canvas, the CLI (`run --batch`) and the MCP `apply` tool all accept exactly these. Each is a JSON object whose `type` is the command name; parameter names are `snake_case`. Required parameters are in bold.

The full JSON Schema of the request protocol is [commands.json](commands.json), the output of `processcraft-cli commands --json`. [Batches and the command pipeline](../developers/batches.md) explains how they are applied.

| Command | What it does | Parameters |
|---|---|---|
| `addLane` | Add a lane above or below a lane or pool | **`document_id`** (DocumentId), **`diagram_id`** (ElementSelector), **`element_id`** (ElementSelector), **`location`** (LaneLocation) |
| `addResource` | Add resource | **`resource`** (Resource) |
| `align` | Align shapes | **`document_id`** (DocumentId), **`diagram_id`** (ElementSelector), **`shape_ids`** (ElementSelector[]), **`alignment`** (Alignment) |
| `append` | Append an auto-placed connected element | **`document_id`** (DocumentId), **`diagram_id`** (ElementSelector), **`source_id`** (ElementSelector), **`kind`** (NodeKind), **`name`** (string or null), **`node_id`** (ElementIdentity), **`shape_id`** (ElementIdentity), **`flow_id`** (ElementIdentity), **`edge_id`** (ElementIdentity) |
| `applyLayout` | Apply layout | **`proposal`** (LayoutProposal) |
| `assignLane` | Assign lane | **`document_id`** (DocumentId), **`process_id`** (ElementSelector), **`element_id`** (ElementSelector), **`lane_id`** (ElementSelector or null), **`bounds`** (ShapeBounds[]) |
| `batch` | Apply batch | **`mutations`** (Mutation[]) |
| `connect` | Connect elements (flow kind chosen by BPMN rules) | **`document_id`** (DocumentId), **`diagram_id`** (ElementSelector), **`source_id`** (ElementSelector), **`target_id`** (ElementSelector), **`flow_id`** (ElementIdentity), **`edge_id`** (ElementIdentity) |
| `createAt` | Create an element at a drop point | **`document_id`** (DocumentId), **`diagram_id`** (ElementSelector), **`kind`** (NodeKind), **`name`** (string or null), **`center`** (Point), **`node_id`** (ElementIdentity), **`shape_id`** (ElementIdentity), **`flow_id`** (ElementIdentity or null), **`edge_id`** (ElementIdentity or null) |
| `createAttributeDefinition` | Create attribute definition | **`definition`** (AttributeDefinition) |
| `createCategory` | Create category | **`document_id`** (DocumentId), **`category`** (Category) |
